title: Live Eye: Voice. Talk on your stream
summary: Streamers can now use a microphone on the Live Eye, and TVs on the train play the stream's sound. Mute streamers you would rather not hear, and report anyone out of line.
highlights: Mic for the Live Eye, off until you turn it on in the Stream settings.
TVs on the train play the stream's sound; placed TVs fade with distance, further for bigger screens.
Mute the stream or one streamer; report a streamer in game or from the live page.
Only select accounts talk on the official Twitch, and only select accounts reach kids.
description:
Streamers can now use a microphone on the Live Eye. It is off until you turn it on in the Stream settings, and the mic beside LIVE in your inventory shows when you are being heard.

TVs on the train now play the live stream's sound. A TV you wear or hold plays flat; a placed TV plays from where it stands and fades with distance, further for bigger screens.

Lots of new settings can be found to enable or disable, to set things up how you like, in Options, Dungeon Train, Stream. Including muting specific streamers. Streamers can be reported in game, or from the browser live stream, for harassment or inappropriate language.

Only select accounts will be able to talk on the official Twitch. Only select accounts will reach kids.
